items.title: What Could Netflix (NFLX) Gain From Owning The Radford Studio Center?
items.summary: Netflix (NasdaqGS:NFLX) is in advanced talks to acquire the Radford Studio Center in Los Angeles, according to recent reports. The Radford Studio Center is a long established Hollywood production lot that currently hosts multiple television and film projects. This would be Netflix's first purchase of a full scale studio campus in California, shifting it from tenant to owner operator.
